professionalSummary.text: Reliability analyst with 3+ years of experience building survival and degradation models for industrial pump maintenance intervals.

professionalSummary.text: Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering with postgraduate applied statistics coursework.
professionalSummary.witness: Education: BEng, Mechanical Engineering, 2018; postgraduate modules in applied statistics at a distance-learning university, two of eight modules completed in 2023 and 2024, no award.

professionalSummary.text: Reviewed field failure data monthly with service engineers under a documented data quality procedure.
professionalSummary.witness: Reviewed the field failure data with the service engineers each month under the team's data quality procedure, keeping the exclusion log for mislabelled failures.

professionalSummary.text: Authored model limitation notes and interval boundary statements for contract customers.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the model limitation notes and the interval boundary statements sent to contract customers with each interval recommendation, and presented the recommendations to two contract customers with the head of fleet analytics.

experienceHighlights.text: Three years and seven months as a reliability analyst on the pump fleet analytics team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reliability analyst on the pump fleet analytics team of a pump service company for three years and seven months, building the survival and degradation models behind the maintenance intervals for two pump families.

experienceHighlights.text: Eighteen months as a maintenance planning analyst at a paper mill, utilizing failure records for overhaul planning.
experienceHighlights.witness: Before the pump service company, eighteen months as a maintenance planning analyst at a paper mill, using the mill's failure records to plan overhauls.

skills.text: Survival analysis, degradation modeling, data quality procedures, model documentation, client presentation.
